sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United, sitting top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and on an impressive run of five straight wins, host Alsager Town at home on Saturday. Alsager arrive as one of the division's struggling sides, currently bottom with just 4 points from 10 matches and on a five-game losing streak, making this a fixture that should suit the in-form leaders.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a match that could have title-race implications, with Stafford just two points behind the leaders. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table and fresh off a loss, host Eccleshall in a local derby that pits sixth-placed Eccleshall against the third-ranked team. Wolverhampton Casuals entertain Wednesfield Community in a mid-table fixture between two sides separated by six points in the standings. Bilston Town, fifth with 17 points, visit Foley Meir in an encounter between teams in mid-table contention. Market Drayton Town, struggling with five losses in their last six outings, face a tough test against New Mills, who have themselves been inconsistent. Crewe and Allscott Heath meet at home to the former, with both teams battling to climb out of the lower half of the table. Brereton Social host Widnes Town in a contest between two struggling sides—Widnes have won just once all season and are rock-bottom with 2 points. Shawbury United, winless in their last five fixtures, welcome Barnton, who come in on a winning streak. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to face Telford Town in a basement battle between the two sides closest to the foot of the table.
